reader.requirement: At --std 85, a level-88 entry must be refused when it follows an elementary item whose usage is INDEX, whether the item writes USAGE INDEX itself (01, 77 or subordinate levels) or inherits it from a group's USAGE INDEX (§1985:VI.5.14.4 GR1). Condition-names on other items must stay accepted.
reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|CobolVersion|ConstructRegistry|Edition over CheckConditionNameAssociationsPass.cs and ItemCategory.cs: the only uses are Edition.At / Edition.Error (location and sink). The exclusion table is edition-free
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers an 01 USAGE INDEX item followed by an 88. Group-inherited INDEX, a 77-level index item and the accepted control are not exercised.

probes.printed: COBOL1976 on IX-ONE (01 USAGE IS INDEX), GA-ONE (elementary item inheriting group USAGE INDEX), GB-TWO (INDEX written under an INDEX group, VALUES 2 THRU 3), IY-Z (77 INDEX)
probes.expected: every elementary index item refused as a conditional variable (§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR7)
index items without condition-names, used in SET, still work, and an 88 on a numeric display item is accepted

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR7  (5.14.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7
OK  §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR2  (5.3.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: IsIndexMessageTagObjectOrPointer reads both the written usage (OwnUsage) and the resolved one (Pic.Usage), so an inherited group INDEX is caught. Under §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR2 c, a group USAGE INDEX followed by an 88 is excluded anyway. The diagnostic cites §2023 SR24 e / SR11, but the behaviour matches the 1985 rule.

refuter.evidence: rix1 (--std 85 compile-only): COBOL1976 on an 88 after an INDEX item with OCCURS 3, after an 01 INDEX REDEFINES PIC X(8), after 05 INDEX (no USAGE keyword) with VALUES ARE 1 THRU 4, and after LINKAGE SECTION 01 and subordinate INDEX items. All refused; the reader's accepted control (88 on a display numeric) stands. The diagnostic cites §2023 text, not §1985, but the refused set is the 1985 one (also §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR2d). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.5.14.3 SR7; OK §1985:VI.5.3.4 GR2.
